senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (अर्हति)
1 To worship or honour.
2 To be fit or worthy: in the first sense it is also r. 10th cl. (अर्हयति.)

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
1 Proper, fit, becoming.
2 Deserving, entitled to, worthy.
m. (-र्हः)
INDRA.
f. (-र्हा)
Worship.
E.
अर्ह to worship, to be fit, अच् aff.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Worship, adoration, respect, courtesy, treating with veneration or respect.
E.
अर्ह to worship, and युच् aff.

mfn. (-न्-न्ती-त्)
1 Venerable, respectable.
2 Praised, celebrated.
m. (-न्)
1 A Jina or Jaina saint and teacher.
2 A Jain or follower of the doctrines of Jina.
3 A religious mendicant of that sect.
E.
अर्ह to worship, &c. and शतृ affix, of the present participle.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Best, most worthy.
E.
अर्हन् respectable, डतम aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
More worthy, better.
E.
अर्हत् and डत्तर aff.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A Saugata or follower of the doctrines of Buddha.
2 A religious mendicant of the same sect.
3 A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अर्ह to worship, &c. and अन्त irregular aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Saluted, honoured, worshipped.
E.
अह to worship, &c. and क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं)
Venerable, respectable, right, fit.
E.
अह and यत् affix: also with अनीयर affix, अर्हणीय.

m. (-तः)
A Jaina, a follower of the doctrines of a Jina or Arhat.
E.
अर्हत् a Jina, अण् aff.

n. (-त्यं-न्ती)
The quality or practice of an Arhat or Jain saint.
E.
अर्हत् ष्यञ् affix fem. ङीष् with the nasal inserted.
